title_en: 47th Infantry Division, volunteers to develop the village school in Choenam before the start of the new academic year.
summary_en: The 47th Special Task Force Rangers, ranger battalion 4704 led volunteers to participate in the cleanup of the area around Ban Choun School, village 1, Phueang Village, Krong Pinang District, Yala Province. Volunteers worked together to clean and improve the landscape around the school so that it is a clean place with orderly structure.
